relations.reading: A testable question is whether newly perceived options become usable only when the operating architecture also permits action.

relations.title: Coeficiente de recuperación de capacidad (ρ)
relations.reading: The recovery coefficient turns the atrophy claim into a bounded question: how much released capacity becomes genuine contribution again for the same capability and cohort?

relations.title: Activación y cierre de misión
relations.reading: An intense intervention should end with recovery and transfer conditions that preserve the team's capability rather than treating sustained overload as proof of commitment.

relations.title: Condiciones de activación de capacidad
relations.reading: The talent-formation model suggests how coherence-carrying capacity could be cultivated and observed through work rather than inferred from credentials or headcount.

relations.title: Unidad de medida de HID
relations.reading: The 01K extension imports the HID research line while keeping runtime response capacity distinct from instrument-gated architectural debt measurement.

relations.title: Autoridad de decisión
relations.reading: Human accountability requires effective intervention capacity as well as authority; a nominal approval does not repair an unsupported or time-expired decision.

relations.title: Transmisión de juicio tácito
relations.reading: Tacit-knowledge transmission could inform a recovery study that distinguishes freed hours from renewed capability to handle novel exceptions.

relations.title: Coste de claridad
relations.reading: The human cost of clarity includes keeping intervention capacity available, maintaining it and qualifying alternative information routes, not only time spent on a case.
